stem: Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, has an ARPA of €40 a month, a gross margin of 60% and an average monthly logo churn rate of 2.0% over the last 6 months. Its blended CAC is €400. Using LTV = ARPA × gross margin / monthly logo churn, what is the LTV to CAC ratio? Give the ratio with 1 decimal.
